note: CD437, avrainvillamide and LRRK2-IN-1 were selected for predicted binding across receptor panels; no administered treatment or measured BUBR1 rescue is described.

title: Catalase Expression Is an Independent Prognostic Marker in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
model: LUAD TCGA, CL1 progression lines and CAT-silenced A549
note: Catalase expression predicted favorable survival and CAT silencing increased growth/BUB1B/PLK1/PKMYT1; no administered catalase or antioxidant benefit was tested.

title: A Bioinformatics Analysis Identifies the Telomerase Inhibitor MST-312 for Treating High-STMN1-Expressing Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
model: STMN1-high HCC cells and connectivity analyses
note: MST-312 reduced viability and STMN1/BUB1B/MCM5 protein, with STMN1 overexpression enhancing sensitivity; telomerase-inhibitor effect is tumor killing, not normal tissue restoration.

title: Integrated bioinformatic analysis reveals the gene signatures, epigenetic roles, and regulatory networks in endometriosis.
model: Six endometriosis transcriptomic datasets
note: BUB1B was one of fifteen hub genes in ECM/p53/focal-adhesion enriched networks; study maps miRNA/lncRNA candidates without administered treatment.

title: Identification of common hub genes in gastrointestinal cancers and their role in prognosis and Immune cell infiltration in hepatocellular carcinoma

title: Identification of hub genes involved in the occurrence and development of hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatics analysis.
model: HCC GEO/TCGA/Oncomine expression cohorts

title: BubR1 insufficiency impairs angiogenesis in aging and in experimental critical limb ischemic mice.

model: HCC/adjacent tissue sequencing, qPCR/IHC and TCGA

title: Upregulation of BUB1B, CCNB1, CDC7, CDC20, and MCM3 in Tumor Tissues Predicted Worse Overall Survival and Disease-Free Survival in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients.
model: HCC GEO and TCGA expression-survival datasets
note: BUB1B/CCNB1/CDC7/CDC20/MCM3 elevation tracked advanced grade, vascular invasion and worse outcomes; proposed targets were not pharmacologically tested.

model: GBM low-grade/advanced expression networks; related preprint to PMID40168776
note: Another complete saved preprint repeats BUB1B-containing mitotic signature and inflammatory advanced-GBM hubs; no independent intervention or rescue result.

title: Transcriptomic landscape of quiescent and proliferating human corneal stromal fibroblasts.
model: Primary human corneal stromal fibroblasts
note: Serum-free versus serum-fed cultures differed in growth/ECM programs, with BUB1B among downregulated cycle genes in quiescence; serum conditions are not a specific rescue drug.

title: Identification of core genes for early diagnosis and the EMT modulation of ovarian serous cancer by bioinformatics perspective.
